title: lightweight-slo-proxy-and-fallback-audit-trace
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a lightweight SLO proxy that softens SLO enforcement for degraded regions and emits audit traces for fallback decisions; fixes a KV sync bug that could leave circuits stuck open. Backward compatible; rollout gated by feature flag.
description: Context: We saw a recurrence of partial-regional degradations where aggressive per-tenant circuit opens + strict SLO kill switches caused broad failovers and client-visible errors (SUP-903). Motivation: Reduce blast radius by introducing a thin SLO proxy layer that can temporarily 'soften' SLO enforcement for specific regions/tenants while keeping full observability of fallback decisions. This PR implements a lightweight SLO proxy and an associated fallback audit trace so operator and postmortem teams can reconstruct why a request was routed to fallback. Summary of change: 1) runtime/slo_proxy: new component that intercepts regional routing decisions and applies a configurable SLO widening window (default +30s) per-tenant when health signals indicate transient churn. 2) runtime/circuit: sticky probation window (per-tenant) to avoid immediate reopen/close flips; fixes KV sync race that left some circuits permanently open after partial sync. 3) observability/traces: new structured audit event "slo.fallback.decision" with fields (timestamp, tenant_id, reason, upstream_region, chosen_route, circuit_state_snapshot) emitted to tracing pipeline. 4) testing/integration: new unit and e2e harness with synthetic regional degradation replay; new perf benchmark. Files touched (high level): runtime/slo_proxy.go, runtime/circuit_manager.go, tracing/audit_traces.proto, deploy/feature_flags.yaml, tests/e2e/slo_proxy_replay_test.go, docs/ops/slo-proxy.md. Migration & rollout: gated behind feature flag: feature.slo_proxy = off by default. Rollout plan: canary -> 10% regional traffic for 24h -> 50% -> full. Monitoring: added metrics slo_proxy.widen_count, slo_proxy.decision_latency_ms, audit_traces.emitted. Backward compatibility: API surface unchanged; all behavior is opt-in through feature flag. Performance: microbenchmarks show median decision CPU cost ~0.08ms per request; 99p extra tail latency < 1ms in our benchmark. Reasonable tradeoff given reduced failover churn. Safety nets: - Automatic disable on increased error rates by circuit-manager if global error rate > 2x baseline for 5m. - Rollback script provided in deploy/rollback_slo_proxy.sh. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] perf benchmarks [x] docs updated [x] feature flag gating [x] rollout plan included
